name: Dahlem (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dahlem (a red eagle above crossed hammers on white and red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident of 6 April 1976 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms, a seal and a flag (banner), the banner red-white striped lengthwise 1:1 with the shield above the centre.

features.role: Dahlem arms — eagle and crossed hammers
